# External Reference Source (Inert)

The exact MIT-licensed Matt Pocock skills snapshot is stored under [mattpocock](./mattpocock/snapshot.json). It is documentation and upstream source material, **not** a runnable or auto-discovered TranslateIT Skill. The registered six application Skills remain in [../skills](../skills) and governed by [../skill-registry.json](../skill-registry.json).

Do not execute vendored shell scripts, load its plugin manifest as host configuration, install dependencies, enable network/CI, launch autonomous subagents or import its upstream root governance. Read approved techniques selectively using the [local method overlay](../methods/README.md). License and original attribution are preserved in [mattpocock/LICENSE](./mattpocock/LICENSE).
